svg.aria-label: Line chart of magnitude in dB against frequency from 0 to 1,000 kHz for eight taps of one LC delay line at Q 10 and Q 30. Later taps roll off earlier; the band up to 250 kHz stays within a few dB.

g.text: |H| at taps 0 to 7, dB · solid Q 10 · dashed Q 30
one LC line of 56 sections, 120 µH and 120 pF each, tapped every 8 sections. Each colour is one tap, nearest first.
every section is a low-pass, so each later tap loses more of the top end: by tap 7 the line has carried 7π radians
of phase at Nyquist, and phase costs about 1/(2Q) nepers a radian.
the symbol stream runs at 125 kBd so the band that matters (amber) stays inside a 3 dB loss budget; the network is
